author: Pulse, brief 013 third pass, 2026-10-16
note: The behaviour layer on Motive's ONE dial. The dial itself (counts, dispatch, reinforcement, caps, seal per security level S0-S4; S = district securityBase + open cases/2 (cap +2) + mission securityBonus) is `response.levels` in motive-takedowns.md 5.3 and is copied here only as `dial` for reference: Motive's file wins. The second-pass profiles, watch level and per-mission modifiers are removed. Nothing here is in the rulebook. Every number is [S].

dial.unit: a unit is 2 officers (health 3, 220 cm/s); a robot is a patrol unit (health 4, pistol, trained, counts against the 30 cap)
dial.seal: starts only at a confirmation at Alert >= 2 (gunfire: from arrival)

patrol.origin: sweep (its current position) for the existing patrol; docks for further robots

officer.origin: post, else the district mouth (legacy site)

warden.does: converge, hold a point, watch, ring the desk, never fight; off unless Motive and Sky choose it (Call 3)

order: the missing person's duties and ties now (post, bound vehicle, expected stand of lover, family, workmate): Motive 5.2
the raiser's ties' expected places now, up to alarm-spread: Sky's words
at Alert 3, the units the dial adds post at district mouths
destinations.dedupe: within witness-range-m (13 m) collapse into the first
destinations.assignment: destination by destination in order, the free unit of an allowed class with the smallest travel time in ticks, ties on unit id; reinforcements go to the destination with the fewest units, ties in list order; one A* per unit at assignment; re-run only at the next landed alarm or Alert step

launch.dispatch: dial.dispatchS after the landing; a patrol robot's wire robot-wire-s 4

arrival.then: robots and patrol hold the point (a watcher's cone); officers search 60 s, at Alert >= 2 opening every stash within 30 m, 10 s each, nearest first
arrival.standDown: 60 s after the last alarm at Alert 1; 180 s at Alert 2; never within the mission at Alert 3

optionalLevers.robot-alarm-cm-s: 85 default; 120 or 150 makes the same S arrive sooner
optionalLevers.hero-block: per Hero step +3 s dispatch and -10% speed; default off
optionalLevers.warden: unarmed civic robot class; default off

readability.dockFlash: the alert glyph on the landing
readability.forecast: hover on ground: 'response here: robots n s, police m s' from distance fields built at load; equals the outcome except the sweep position and busy units
readability.chips: first unit of each class always; others on hover or select; at most 12 with chips; dock and post stock as pips
readability.orderCard: Motive 5.3: 'Alert 2 - police in ~n s - +1 unit every 40 s'

cost: a unit is a stored route and a position lookup per tick; 40 units under 10 microseconds a tick; one A* (0.6 ms) per assignment
